body:
### Unsafe concurrent price stream owner

`usePerpsTopMovers` calls `usePerpsLiveMarketListData` even though the Perps tab already owns that stream via `usePerpsTabExploreData`. That hook activates `usePerpsLivePrices` with a global, non-ref-counted `perpsDeactivatePriceStream` cleanup that assumes a single owner, so one instance tearing down can stop live price updates for the whole tab and adds a second 30s `refresh` interval.
action: Already fixed on this branch by making usePerpsTopMovers a pure ranking function over markets passed in from the tab owner.

body:
### Toggle track loses screen inset

The Gainers/Losers track and its screen inset now share one `Box`. `className` `p-1` is twMerged last and overrides `paddingLeft`/`paddingRight`, so the bordered control goes edge-to-edge while the header and pill list stay on the `px-4` inset.
action: Split px-4 onto a wrapper Box and kept p-1 on the bordered track.

body:
### Pills clip labels in popup

Pills switched from content-width (`w-auto shrink-0`) to `flex-1` / `min-w-0` in rows of four. In the 400px popup each pill is too narrow for the logo, ticker, and 24h change, and `ButtonBase`'s `overflow-hidden` clips those labels instead of wrapping to two columns.
action: Restored w-auto shrink-0 so pills size to their labels and wrap.

body:
`p-1` here overrides the `paddingLeft={4}` / `paddingRight={4}` above it - Box does `twMerge(...paddingProps, className)` with `className` last, so `p-1` wins and the bordered track loses the `px-4` inset the header and pills keep.
Splitting them fixes it: inset on a wrapper Box, p-1 on the bordered track.
action: Applied the suggested wrapper split so inset and track padding are on different Boxes.
